༄༅// dbu ma lugs kyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga theg chen grong mchog 'jug pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// phyi mo mnyam pa dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor las yi ge zhe gnyis/ lci ba nyer gnyis/ yang ba nyi shu/ phyi mo re bzhi pa 'phags ma'i dbyangs kyis nye bar spud pa'o// ༄༅// shrīmāṃkulishaṃtik+ṣ+ṇobhawātra/ satwān+nayāyadzātermāyaiḥpaṭutrinīyaish+shāsanabhaskar/ yat+p+radzashirasisadābidzayan+tu// ༄༅// dpal ldan rdo rje rnon po srid pa 'dir// 'gro ba gdon phyir skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// mkhas tshul gsum gyis bstan pa snang byed gang*// skye dgu'i gtsug na rtag par rgyal gyur cig /yid bzang dbang po ltos 'phye 'khor los sgyur// sbyin skyes gan+dharba yi rgyal po sogs// khengs ldan nor bu'i cod paṇa zhabs kyi rdul// 'bab stegs byas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dud// thugs bskyed thog ma'i sa bon btab nas brtsams// gzhan don spyod pa dpag yas yal ga 'dab// grangs med bskal pa'i phreng bar bskyed bsrings pas// byang chub dpag bsam snye ma g.yur za ba// gang de'i yon tan phyogs re'i 'phrin yig kyang*// bskal pa'i dbyar ring las skyes snyug gu dang*// chu gter rnam bzhi 'dri byed khams song yang*// mthas gtugs dben pa'i rgyal kun skyed pa'i yab// srid gsum gdul byar gyur pa'i sa chen gsum// stong nyid snying rje'i gom pas yongs bcal te// bdag don gces 'dzin stobs ldan mthar byed pa'i// rgyal sras rnam gnon mtha' dag 'jug pa'i sgo// 'phags bod yul gyi rgyas sras mchog zung gi /gzhung don bla med byang chub mchog tu sems// skyed byed thabs kyi kun phan dkyil 'khor las// phan bde'i ga pur zegs ma 'bum 'dzag pa// rnam gsal bgyid la don gnyer tshangs pa'i bu// sngon med dga' ba'i ro brgya 'thungs pa'i mchu// rgya skyegs kyis dmar 'dzum pa'i khong gsing las// rus pa'i ge sar ga zha 'byin snyam byos// de la 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/

dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa slob dpon chen po rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i lugs ltar smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi cho ga byed pa la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi ston pa'i sku dang*/ sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga'i rten bris 'bur rab gnas can gyis mtshon pa'i rten gsum khyad par can/ de'i mdun du nyer spyod zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po dang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum mam bzhi rnams legs par bsham mo// de nas slob dpon rang nyid khrus byas/ rten gyi spyan sngar langs te phung po gsum pa'i mdo tshar gsum brjod kyin phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bzang spyod smon lam gyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i ji snyed su dag ces sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ thal mo sbyar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ ngag tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang gi ming nas smos te bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas rnams la zhes sogs nas tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs nas bslab par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum dang*/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu zhes sogs dang byang chub sems ni rin po che zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs nas rang rgyud kyi sdom pa rnam par dag par byas/ de nas chos kyi khri chen po'i steng du gdan mthon po la 'khod do// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems can thams cad phan bde la dgod par 'dod pa'i brtse ba dang*/

khyad par du slob ma rnams la byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems brtan pas// ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i khur shes rgyud kyi steng na bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa de dag ma bshags na/ dge ba byas pa stobs chung zhing 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lam du mi 'gyur bas bshags dgos/ de'ang stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags na sdig pa ji ltar che yang 'dag par gsungs pas/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ bstan pa'i bdag po shākya seng ge sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag gnyis sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du ltung ba bshags pa'i yul sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga bzhugs par mos te/ de'ang dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir dkar po bdun ni byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ sngon po bdun ni sa gnon gyi phyag rgya/ ser po bdun ni mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ dmar po bdun ni mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya/ ljang gu bdun ni skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bzhugs par bsam/ gzhan yang mtha' skor kun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs par mos pa bya ba ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gi drung du bdag gzhan sems can thams cad lus dang mgo bo dang lce dpag tu med par sprul te/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po byed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi byed snyam pa gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs/

de ltar byas pas ltung ba thams cad dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs te/ de dag dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas ltung ba bshags pa tshar gsum phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te gdon du gzhug go /de nas slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chen bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bu la yang dag par bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la thog mar 'di ltar nges pa bya dgos te/ 'o skol rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir 'bad 'tshal te/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rgya mtsho gcig gnas gnya' shing bu ga dang*// rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las// mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis// dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod// ces gsungs shing*/ dam pa'i chos rnams kyi nang nas kyang bdag gzhan thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las sgrol zhing*/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad thob par byed pa'i rgyu byang chub kyi sems yin te/ bslab btus las/ sdug bsngal mthar 'byin 'dod pa dang*// bde ba'i mthar yang 'gro 'dod pas// dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan bya ste// byang chub la ni blo brtan bya// zhes gsungs pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga de 'dir bgyi/ 'di la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung nas sems bskyed la dbu ma lugs dang sems tsam lugs gnyis yod/ dbu ma lugs ni sdong po bkod pa dang nam mkha'i snying pos zhus pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs/

'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis gsungs/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub nas brgyud/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i lugs/ slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i phyag len/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa la sogs pas mdzad pa 'di yin/ sems tsam lugs ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la sogs pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs/ 'phags pa byams pas gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med nas brgyud/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi'i lugs/ jo bo chen po rje'i phyag len/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams mdzad pa 'di yin/ 'di gnyis la blang ba'i yul/ len pa'i gang zag len pa'i cho ga blangs nas srung tshul/ nyams na phyir bcos pa rnams mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mang du yod ces gsungs shing*/ yang mkhas pa 'ga' zhig de gnyis kyi dbye ba dang khyad par la sogs pa mi 'thad ces gsung yang*/ 'dir dgag sgrub btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i gsung rab las ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa mya ngan med dpal/ don yod rdo rje/ paṇa chen puṇ+ya shrī/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal/ gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'phags sde dpal ldan grags pa/ mkhan po grags pa rgya mtsho/ rin chen grags pa/ mkhan po sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya'i mkhan chen bsod nams bkra shis/ grub chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bkra shis bzang po/ de las bdag tshul khrims rin chen gyis mnos pa ltar cho ga bgyid pa la don rnam pa gsum ste/

bsam pa'i rten nges par bya ba/ sbyor ba rjes su sgrub pa/ rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po bsam pa'i rten nges par bya ba la/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtha' la skyo ba bskyed pa/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa dgag pa/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lam byang chub kyi sems la spro ba bskyed pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ dmyal ba la rigs bco brgyad yod pa las/ tsha dmyal ni/ yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa ste brgyad yin la/ de rnams la phan tshun mtshon gyis 'debs pa dang*/ sog les 'gra ba dang*/ ri gnyis 'dus nas bcom pa dang*/ lcags mdung me 'bar ba bsnun nas lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la brdabs pa dang*/ lcags kyi khang pa me 'bar ba sgo med pa'i nang du chud pa dang*/ zangs chen po'i nang du bzod thabs med pa'i chu tshan gyis btsos pa dang*/ phyogs bcu thams cad mes gang bas sreg pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod cing*/ de thams cad mi dge ba chen po'i 'bras bu yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las/ gshin rje'i skyes bus pags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing*// rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zangs zhun lus la blugs gyur la// 'bar ba'i ral gri mdung thung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar lhags shing*// shin tu 'bar ba'i lcags kyi sa gzhir ltung bar mi dge mang pos 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ grang dmyal ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol pa/ a chu zer ba/ kyi hud zer ba/ so tam tam pa/ at+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ste brgyad yin la/ de dag shin tu grang bas lus la chu bur gyi tshogs byung zhing smre sngags 'don pa dang*/ sha rus gas pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/ slob spring las/ lhags pa dpe med rus pa la yang thim pa yis// lus sbrebs 'dar sha bskur nas kum kum por 'dug pa// chu bur brgya byung rdol pa las skyes srog chags kyis// ral gris dbad nas zhag dang chu ser rkang bcas 'dzag

/ces gsungs/ nye 'khor ba ni/ me ma mur gyi 'obs chen por lhung ba dang*/ ro myags kyi 'dam du lhung nas srog chags kyis sha rus 'bigs pa dang*/ spu gri brdal ba'i thang la lus gang reg spu gris gcod pa dang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags rlung gis bskyod pas/ ral gri chad nas las dum bur gtong ba dang*/ shal ma ri'i sdong po lcags kyi tsher ma sor bcu drug yod pa la 'bab 'dzegs byas pas lus rgyus pa bshad pa bzhin 'gro ba dang*/ chu bo rab med ces bya ba chu shin tu tsha bar lhung nas lus rus par zangs kyis gtong ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod cing*/ de dag tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i phyogs bzhi na thams cad tshang ba re re yod de/ mdzod las/ de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na// me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam// spu gri lam sogs chu bo yin// zhes gsungs/ nyi tshe ba ni/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram la sogs pa sna tshogs na yod cing*/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ srog chags kyis za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod pas/ de ltar dmyal ba pa rnams la sdug bsngal shin tu mang po yod de/ bshes spring las/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la'ang*// 'ol yang mi mchi char yang mi phod do// zhes gsungs/ yi dwags rnams la lo zla mang por zas skom cung zad kyang mi rnyed pas/ bkres skom gyis gzir ba dang*/ tsha grang la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis// bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa// bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis// bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ dud 'gro rnams la'ang gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ bkol ba dang*/ sha dang*/ pags pa la sogs pa'i ched du gsod pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/ bshes spring las/

dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang bsad pa dang*// bcing dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa// kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan gyi rdog pa lag pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus btab pas btab ste bkol// ces gsungs/ mi rnams la'ang skye rga na 'chi dang*/ med pa btsal du ma rnyed pa dang*/ yod pa bsrung gis ma thub pa dang*/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa dang*/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po 'dug pa de rang res mthong ba 'di yin/ lha ma yin rnams la lha'i dpal 'byor la phrag dog byed pas lus gshag pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po yod de/ lha min gnas na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi// dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che// de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi// sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so// zhes gsungs/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams la yang 'chi ltas byung ba'i dus su lha'i dpal 'byor la chags shing*/ de nas 'chi bar shes nas sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ste/ mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi /'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che// zhes gsungs so// gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams kyi lha rnams la re zhig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal med kyang*/ de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song rnams su'ang skye bar 'gyur ba yod de/ lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang*// tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa bsten 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs/ des na 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te*/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam yang*// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs shing*/

mgon po byams pas kyang*/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ ces gsungs/ des na 'khor ba mtha' dag las skyo ba skyed cing de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya ba de las dgos pa che ba gzhan ni 'ga' yang med de/ bshes spring las/ mgo'am gos la glo bur me shor na// de dag bzlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang*// yang srid med par bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te// 'di bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis// zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor ba las thar bar bya ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos la 'bad par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa bskyed 'tshal lo// gnyis pa zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la zhen pa dgag pa ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas/ de spangs nas nyan rang gi lugs kyi phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das thob na/ sdug bsngal gtan nas med par 'gyur bas de thob par bya ba yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ des gzhan don mi 'grub la/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas mar byas pa'i drin can yin pas/ de rnams kyi don mi byed par rang nyid lhag med kyi myang 'das sgrub pa ni/ drin mi shes pas khrel med pa'i spyod par 'gyur te/ slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa// klong gi nang na ltung ba lta bur snang bzhin du// skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas// gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med// byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pa// gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis zags 'thungs pa// ngal ba mang brten byams pa brten pa de dag 'dir// shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan don dor nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde thob par 'dod pa'i blo spang 'tshal lo// gsum pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lam byang chub kyi sems la spro ba skyed pa ni/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas spang dgos shing*/

sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa'i myang 'das de'ang thob par mi byed na/ ci zhig thob par bya ba yin snyam na/ myang 'das phyogs gcig pa de thob par bya ba ma yin yang*/ mgon po byams pas/ bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bsal nas// sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min// de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs brten nas// 'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pas na mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ste/ de nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de thob na rang don du spangs rtogs thams cad mthar phyin/ gzhan don du 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par phrin las grangs med pa 'bad med lhun grub tu mdzad pas na/ rang gzhan gyi don mthar thug pa yin pas/ de thob par bya ba'i phyir yin no// de thob byed kyi rgyu de ni gtso bo byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin te rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud las/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so zhes gsungs shing*/ mdo sdud pa las/ de bzhin 'dir yang byang chub sems med bde gshegs kyi// ye shes 'jig rten 'di dag kun du ga la 'byung*// zhes sems bskyed med na sangs rgyas mi 'byung la// chu yi thigs pas bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar// rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yongs 'gengs pa ltar// de bzhin dang po'i sems kyang byang chub mchog rgyu ste// rim gyis dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyam pa'i spro ba chen po bskyed par zhu/ gnyis pa sbyor ba rjes su sgrub pa la/

gang las blang ba'i yul dang*/ gang gis len pa'i gang zag dang*/ ji ltar len pa'i tshul gyi cho ga dang gsum las/ dang po gang las blang ba'i yul ni/ theg pa chen po la mos shing theg chen gyi chos la mkhas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen las blang bar bya ste/ bslab btus las/ sdom pa gzung ba yang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas la mos pa lhur byed pa/ sdom pa dang ldan pa las blang bar bya ste/ zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa gang gis len pa'i gang zag ni/ shes rab kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rnams legs par rtogs shing*/ de dag shin tu sgrub dka' bar shes kyang*/ snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol bar 'dod cing*/ de la rang gis sangs rgyas thob dgos par shes nas/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par 'dod pa zhig yin te/ bslab btus las/ sems can chen po gang*/ de lta bu thos nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dka' ba shes rab kyis rtogs par byas nas/ skye bo ma lus pa sdug bsngal las bskyab par khur khyer ba des ni/ phyag bya ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba byas la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gsol ba gdab ste/ de'i tshig gis rjes su brjod pa'am/ yang na rang nyid kyis brjod pas zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ji ltar len pa'i tshul gyi cho ga la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gi cho ga dang gsum gyi dang po sbyor ba la/ yul khyad par can la gsol ba gdab pa/

rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba/ thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs bsag cing sgrib pa sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ khyed rnams sems bskyed zhu bar 'dod pas/ slob dpon la gsol ba gdab dgos pas/ slob dpon la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ ces dang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang shes na gang gi mchod rdzas dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang brjod du gzhug go /de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te bdag cag la byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rigs kyi bu bdag la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa rten khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ chos theg pa chen po'i lung dang rtogs pa/ dge 'dun byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams yin la/ dus byang chub snying po'i bar du/ rgyu sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs nas/ ngo bo ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol ba la sangs rgyas thob dgos la/ sangs rgyas thob pa dkon mchog gsum la rag las pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen snyam pa'i dad pa chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dag la dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi ming smos nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/

byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su song nas/ de'i bslab bya la da phyin chad sangs rgyas la ston pa/ theg chen gyi chos la lam/ byang sems 'phags pa rnams la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su gzung bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa mdzod/ gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs bsag cing sgrib pa sbyang ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i yul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pas bskor bas gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsams nas/ rang gi lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam par bsam zhing*/ de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyang khrid de/ thog mar phyag 'tshal bar bsams la rjes zlos kyi tshig rnams dal zhing dod pa skabs phyed par brjod pa shin tu gnad che bas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud nas ni bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa mchod pa dbul ba la bdun las/ dang po dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa ni/ 'di ltar dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di rnams lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo/ gtsang zhing dwangs la thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams khengs pa tsam du bsams nas/ de dag dang gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa na yod pa'i me tog la sogs pa rnams/ bla ma dang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul lo snyam pas mchod pa byin rlabs kun rig ltar dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di lta ste/

rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med sogs mchod yon gyi tshig rkang lnga sngags dang bcas slob dpon gyi ngag nas lan cig brjod la slob ma rnams la bslabs nas/ de lta bu'i rim pas thams cad kyis mchod pa rnams 'bul ba'i rjes zlos mdzad pa zhu zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskul te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ sogs sngags dang phyag rgya bcas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang*// bdag gi gus par bshams pa rnams// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// ci bde bar ni zhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang puṣ+pe sogs sngags dang 'don pa bsgyur te dbul/ bsdus pa byed na sngags rkyang ngam/ tshigs bcad rkyang pas phul yang chog go /gnyis pa bdag po yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i/ rin po che'i ri/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'bru dang me tog sman dang nags tshal la sogs pa thams cad sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul bas/ bdag cag gi tshogs rdzogs pa'i don du khyed rnams kyis bzhes su gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad mas brgyan pa dag

/ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces brjod do// yang bsdus par byed na/ yongs su bzung ba med pa 'di dag kun// zhes pa nas/ bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /ces pa'i bar brjod/ gsum pa lus dbul ba ni/ bdag gi lus 'di sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bran du phul nas/ de dag gi bya ba sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos mdzod/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gis lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan pa bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// zhes brjod/ bzhi pa blos sprul pa'i mchod pa ni/ bdag gi tshig las 'byung ba'i khrus kyi khang pa zhes pa la sogs pa 'di rnams tshigs bcad las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du/ lam lam byung bar bsgoms nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod nas/ rang gi tshig dal la dod pa skabs phyed pas 'di rnams brjod par bya'o// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa dbul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun du bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun du dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man dā ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron ma rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kun// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// zhes brjod par bya'o// lnga pa mchod pa yongs su bsngo ba ni/

de dag las gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyes par byed cing*/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ nam mkha'i khams khyab par gnas par gyur cig snyam du bsams nas rjes zlos mdzod/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ces brjod/ drug pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs pa sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa na/ mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod pa rnams bden par mngon par zhen pa med pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang de ltar mngon par zhen pa med pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod do snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// ces brjod par bya'o// bdun pa bstod pas mchod pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ yon tan tshul bzhin brjod pa'i bstod dbyangs rnams kyis bstod do snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun du 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod nas mdo dbyangs byed du gzhug go /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad sdig pa gtan nas mi byed snyam pa nyes pa las bzlog pa'i stobs dang*/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa rten gyi stobs dang*/ sdig pa'i gnyen po rnams nyams su len pa gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ stobs bzhi tshang bas sdig pa thams cad 'dag par chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs pas/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa dran yul du byas nas de la 'gyod pa drag po dang*/ da phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi byed snyam pa'i zhe bcad chen po dang*/ da ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rten dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sdig pa'i gnyen po'i chos rnams tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pa'i sgo nas/ sdig bshags kyi tshig brjod pas/ sdig pa sangs sangs dag par bsgom zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid// ces lan gsum brjod nas/ sdig pa bden med yin pas sangs dag par bsam mo// bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ 'phags pa dang so so skye bo'i bde ba dang dge ba thams cad la zhe thag pa nas dga' ba'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// zhes brjod/

lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas zhu ba po'i tshogs rdzogs par bya ba la sogs pa'i don du chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba'ang yod pas/ de rnams la gdul bya rnams kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs rnams kun gyis sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron ma sbar du gsol// zhes brjod/ drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas la dkon pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa la sogs pa'i don du/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa yod pas/ de rnams la zhing de rnams kyi gdul bya rnams kyi don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun ring du bzhugs su gsol snyam pa'i bsam pa zhe thag pas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi dgod par// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// zhes brjod/ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du// nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang*// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom gyi gnod pa bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun du nye bar gnas gyur cig

/ces brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la blo sbyong ba dang*/ dam bca' ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas yang dang yang du ma byas pa'i drin can yin la/ de dag 'khor ba na sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas gzir 'dug pas/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad de dag la btang nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gang dang gang dgos pa de 'grub pa'i rgyur gtong zhing*/ dka' spyad dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang du blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phongs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub// thams cad btang bar chabs cig la// sems can rnams la gtong ba mchog /bdag gi lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dang gcod pa dang*// brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la gco byed dam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i// las gang yin pa byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i sems byung ba// de nyid rtag tu de dag gi /don kun grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de bzhin phyar kha gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// mar me 'dod la mar me dang*// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /ces pa'am/ yang na sh+lau ka snga ma dang*/ sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/ zhes pa man chod de sh+lau ka gsum brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa dam bca' ba ni/ chos thams cad don dam par spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral yang*/ kun rdzob tu bdag gzhan bde sdug la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ snang ba de dag mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ thams cad bden pa med pa yin yang*/ sems can rnams kyis de ltar mi shes par bden par bzung bas 'khor bar sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong zhing*/ de ltar sdug bsngal ba'i sems can de thams cad thog ma med pa nas phan btags pa'i drin can yin pas/ de thams cad bdag gis sdug bsngal las bsgral dgos par 'dug da lta bdag la de dag sgrol ba'i nus pa med pas/ de thams cad sgrol ba la sangs rgyas thob dgos par 'dug pas/ bdag gis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims gsum po de la/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ ji ltar bslabs pa de bzhin du bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam zhing*/

dgongs su gsol brjod pa na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag gi bsam sbyor rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen gyin yod pas/ mkhyen gyin yod nges snyam du nges par byas nas/ sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ de'i ched du bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa chen po dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dag la dgongs su gsol/ rang gi ming nas smos te bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o// zhes brjod/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa smon pa'i sems bskyed nas/ 'jug pa byang sems kyi bslab pa/ tshul khrims gsum la rim pa bzhin du bslab pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis la de ltar bslab par bya'o snyam pa'i sems kyis rjes zlos gnyis pa brjod/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa chen po dang*/ sems can la brtse ba chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa chen po ste chen po gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du/ cis kyang sangs rgyas thob par bya zhing*/

sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ tshul khrims gsum po de la nges par bslab par bya'o// de'i dpang por bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams bzhugs so snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos gsum pa 'di shin tu gal che bas bshad pa rnams brda 'phrod pa dang*/ dam bca'i tshig rnams dal zhing dod pa skabs phyed pa brjod pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos gsum pa brjod/ gsum pa rdzogs pa dang smon 'jug gi sems nges par skye ba yin pas skyes snyam pa'i thob shes kyi dga' ba bskyed par zhu/ zhes brjod par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ gtang rag dbul ba dang*/ bslab bya bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po la rang dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ bdag gis thog ma med pa nas lus dpag tu med pa blangs kyang*/ don chen po ma grub pas da dung 'khor bar lus pa yin pa la/ da res rang gzhan thams cad kyi phan bde'i rgyur/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes pas/ don chen po grub snyam pa'i dga' ba bsgom par bya'o// de tsam du dga' ba bsgoms pa'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ phan yon shin tu mang ste/ ming don 'pho ba/ sdig pa stobs chen spong ba/ bsod nams rgya chen thob pa/ yon tan mtha' yas thob pa/ phan yon dpes bstan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba/ phan yon lung dang sbyar ba dang bdun gyi/ dang po ming don 'pho ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sdig pa stobs chen spong ba ni/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// de ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gis ni nges par sreg par byed// ces gsungs so// gsum pa bsod nams rgya chen thob pa ni/

dpas byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste// de bas kyang ni lhag par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa yon tan mtha' yas pa thob pa ni/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dang chos 'dzin dang*// chos sgrub pa dang srog chags snying brtse ba// chos bzhi 'di dag yon tan mthar med de// 'di dag mtha' ni rgyal ba mi gsung ngo*// zhes gsungs so// lnga pa la phan yon dpes bstan pa la gsum las/ dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba gser 'gyur rtsi'i dpes bstan pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung*// zhes gsungs/ rnyed dka' zhing rin che ba rin po che'i dpes bstan pa ni/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos// legs par yongs su brtags nas rin che bas// 'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams// rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par gyur// zhes gsungs/ 'bras bu mi zad cing 'phel ba dpag bsam gyi shing gi dpes bstan pa ni/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu spyad nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// drug pa sangs rgyas la mchod par 'gyur ba ni/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa bla na med pa yin te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang*/ srog chags rnams la snying brtse ba'o zhes dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las kyang*/ gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad mchod 'dod pas// de yis brtan par byang chub sems bskyed bya// zhes dang*/

dpas byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing kun mi gang gis// rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang ste// sangs rgyas rnams la phul ba bas// gang gis thal mo sbyar byas te// byang chub tu ni sems btud na// bsod nams 'di ni khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs so// bdun pa phan yon lung dang sbyar ba ni/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud/ grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas na/ tshong dpon nor brtan gyi bu gzhon nu nor bzangs kyis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi drung du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ ji ltar slob pa'i tshul rgya cher shes par bya ba'i phyir/ bla ma lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bsten zhing*/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas 'ongs te/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram du mgon po byams pa 'khor mang po la chos ston pa de'i drung du byon pa na/ byams pas/ 'khor rnams la nor bzangs bstan na// ltos shig bsam pa yongs su dag pa 'di// nor bzangs nor rnams rab tu brtan pa'i bu// byang chub spyod pa dam pa yongs tshol zhing*// mkhas pa nga yi drung du nye bar 'ongs// legs par 'ongs sam blta na rab zhi ba// legs par 'ongs sam snying rje byams 'byung khyod// dka' ba spyod tshe dub par ma gyur tam// skyo med bsam ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs// dbang po ma zhum tshur shog 'ongs pa legs// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa na/ nor bzangs kyis byams pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ bdag gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed na/ de'i bslab pa rnams la ji ltar slob pa'i tshul rnams ma shes pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob pa'i tshul rnams rgya cher bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ byams pas rigs kyi bu khyod ni/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin to// byang chub kyi sems ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o// 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o// nyes par byas pa thams cad sreg pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'o// mi dge ba'i chos thams cad zad par byed pa'i phyir sa'i 'og lta bu'o// don thams cad yongs su sgrub pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o// bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o// 'khor ba'i chu la rgyu ba 'don pas lcags kyu lta bu'o// lha dang*/

mi dang*/ lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na mchod rten lta bu ste/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji snyed yod pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan dang phan yon yang de snyed do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'di las byung ste/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang 'di las skyes so zhes gsungs/ lung 'di mdo kun las btus las drangs pa ltar bris pa yin no// de ltar yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes pa de la dga' spro dang ldan zhing*/ 'di ltar 'byung ba'i tshig 'di rnams kyi don la yang legs par sems shing dga' spro bskyed pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// long bas phyag dar phung po las// ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar// de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas// bdag la byang chub sems 'di skyes// 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi// mi zad gter yang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i// sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no// srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi// 'gro ba ngal gso'i ljon shing yin// 'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las// sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dang*// dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin// dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las// mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin// 'gro ba'i mgon po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing*// bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la// 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas nas// sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin// zhes brjod/

yang na tshigs bcad dang po gnyis tsam brjod pas chog go /gnyis pa gzhan dga' ba bsgom du gzhug pa ni/ bdag gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pas/ thams cad dga' bar gyis shig snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa gtang rag gi mchod pa dbul ba ni/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems skyes pa de/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi bka' drin yin pas/ de'i drin lan du dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kha bsos te byin gyis brlabs nas/ gdangs dang bcas te gong ltar 'bul ba dang*/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gi sogs kyis lus dbul ba dang me tog dam sogs bzang spyod las byung ba'i mchod pa sh+lau ka gsum gyis dbul lo// gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sngar bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyar bcas te/ oṃ sar+b+ba gu ru bud+dha dharma saṃ ga te bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro btags pa gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon 'gro'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/

skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya stāṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa gsum dang nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can rnams bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol zhes pas phul/ gtor ma gsum pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyi mthar 'jig rten skyong ba chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig ces dang*/ gtor ma bzhi pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// stob bo// bzhes shig /bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten gyi khams su bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis byang chub sems rin po che bskyed pa la dga' zhing rangs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba'i stong grogs dam pa mdzad cig

sngags kyi mthar gats+tsha btags pas rang gnas su gshegs su gsol lo// gsum pa bslab bya bstan pa la gnyis las/ dang po smon pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya ni/ de ltar sems bskyed nas gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa de yang nas yang du dran par bya zhing*/ bla ma dang sbyin gnas slu ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la mi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo sgyu byed pa dang*/ 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa ste spang bya nag po'i chos bzhi/ de'i gnyen por srog gi phyir yang brdzun mi smra ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing de dag gi yon tan gyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ g.yo sgyu spangs te lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa thams cad nyan rang gi sar ma yin gyi/ theg pa chen por smin par byed pa ste dkar po'i chos bzhi po de la slob pa dang*/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo spangs na smon 'jug gnyis ka spangs par 'gyur bas de mi spong ba shin tu gal che zhing*/ 'phral la yang gzhan don dngos su nus sam mi nus kyang rung ste/ gzhan phan gyi sems ci nus kyis ma nyams par byed pa dang*/ dge ba byed pa thams cad tshogs gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas byed pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon dran par bya ba'i phyir/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ ngan 'gro thams cad bzlog bgyid cing*// mtho ris lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig tu brjod pa'i sgo nas kyang phan yon dran par bya'o// gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la/ spang bya dang bsgrub bya gnyis las/ spang bya ni nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las byung ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa/ phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod// dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa// gnyis pa yin par thub pas gsungs// tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang*// ngur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang*// btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang*// rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang*// srog dang bral byed gsum pa yin// mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang*// log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang*// zhes pa rgyal po la 'byung ba lnga yin la/

de'i dang po bzhi dang*/ grong la sogs pa 'jig pa yang*// rtsa ba'i ltung bar thub pas gsungs// zhes grong 'joms pa'i ltung ba ste/ blon po la 'byung ba lnga yin la/ mdo las rten gyi sgo nas bcur bgrangs la/ rdzas kyi dbang du byas na ltung ba dang po bzhi rdzas bzhi yin zhing*/ rgyal po la log lta 'dzin pa dang*/ blon po la grong 'joms pa ste/ gnyis po de rdzas re re yin pas rdzas drug yin no// las dang po pa la 'byung ba brgyad ni/ blo sbyangs ma byas sems can la// stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang*// sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bzlog pa dang*// so sor thar pa yongs spangs te// theg pa che la sbyor ba dang*// slob pa'i theg pa'i tshogs la sogs// spong bar 'gyur ba min zhes 'dzin// pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang*// rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu yis gzhan smod dang*// bdag ni zab mo bzod pa'o zhes// log pa nyid ni smra ba dang*// dge sbyong chad pas gcod 'jug dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi sbyin byed dang*// sbyin pa len par byed pa dang*// zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang*// yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams// kha ton byed la sbyin pa rnams// de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste// sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu// zhes rten gyi sgo nas bco brgyad du mdo las gsungs la/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bcu bzhi yin no// yang byang sa las byung ba'i don sdom pa nyi shu par/ rnyed dang bkur stir chags pa yis// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la// ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*// gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par// khros nas sems can 'tshog pa dang*// theg pa chen po spong byed cing*// dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o// zhes rtsa ltung bzhi bshad pa la/ dang po ni sngar gyi/

rang gi yon tan brjod pa dang*// rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang*// tshigs bcad rgyu yis gzhan smod dang*// zhes 'byung ba de nyid yin la// lhag ma gsum po bslab btus su// chags dang ser sna mi bzad pas// slong la sbyin par mi byed dang*// sgrims te dga' bar byed pa na// sems can la ni mi bzod par// khro bas sems can brdeg pa dang*// nyon mongs pa dang gzhan mthun pas// chos ltar bcos pa brjod pa'o// zhes pa gsum ste/ rdzas bcu bdun yin la/ yang thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' so sor thar pa'i bslab pa la slob cing*/ bskal pa brgya stong du rtsa ba dang 'bras bu za bar gyur la/ sems can rnams kyis legs par smras pa dang*/ nyes par smras pa la bzod kyang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas gnas na/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba lci ba'o zhes gsungs pa'i don/ bslab btus su/ byang chub sems ni yongs 'dor dang*// zhes 'byung bas rdzas bco brgyad/ rten gyi sgo nas phye na nyi shu rtsa gnyis su slob dpon zhi ba lha bzhed cing*/ rgyal blon las dang po pa zhes rten gyis phye ba gsum po de dag thams cad kyang rten de dang de dag la 'byung nye ba'i ltung ba de dag rten dang de'i ltung ba zhes smos pas/ ltung ba de dag rang rang la mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir bsgrim pa dang*/ byung na dran pa la sogs pa'i don du rten de dag gi ltung ba zhes bstan pa yin gyis/ rten gyis phye ba'i ltung ba bco brgyad po thams cad su la byung yang ltung bar 'gyur bas/ thams cad kyis ltung ba thams cad spang bar bya ste/ bslab btus las/ gang du gang dag la mang du 'byung ba de dag la de rang gi ming nas smos te bstan pas 'jigs pa bskyed pa'i phyir bzlog go /thams cad kyis kyang phan tshun ltung ba thams cad spang bar bya'o zhes gsungs/

gnyis pa bsgrub bya ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i ltung ba rnams spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i dge ba bsgrub par 'dod pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can rnams kyi mthar thug dang gnas skabs kyi phan bde sgrub pa'i don byed par 'dod pa'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims gsum po de la bslab par bya ste/ byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad ni gsum po 'di dag kho nar zad de zhes byang sems kyi bslab bya thams cad de gsum du 'dus pas/ spang bya de rnams spang zhing*/ tshul khrims gsum po de la bslab par bya'o// gal te ltung ba byung na/ rmi lam du 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po spyan drangs nas/ de'i mdun du bshags pa byed par nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las gsungs pas/ bslab btus su/ rmi lam 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bshags tshul rnams bslab btus su shes par bya zhing*/ yang spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// phung po gsum po gdon bya zhing*// rgyal dang byang chub sems brten la// ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya// zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyis ltung ba rnams/ dag par byed pa la bslab par bya'o// 'di dag ni slob dpon zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug dang bslab btus su ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul bkod pa yin no// cho ga myur bar 'dod na yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod las byung ba ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// spyi don gsum pa rang bzhin gtan la dbab pa ni/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo dang*/ rgyu dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sa mtshams dang*/ thob tshul dang*/ cho ga tha dad gsungs tshul la sogs pa rnams yin te/ de dag ni theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las rgyas par shes par bya ba yin no// sems bskyed gcig las gcig gis thob pa'i brgyud pa la slob dpon zhi ba lha med kyang*/

dgra las rnam rgyal gyis sems bskyed kyi cho ga spyod 'jug gi lugs su mdzad cing*/ de man chad de'i rjes su 'brangs ba yin pas/ tshig mi 'dra ba ci rigs pa byung yang*/ don spyod 'jug gi lugs yin te/ bla ma gong ma'i rnam gzhag las kyang*/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i lugs zhes gsungs so// yang dgra las rnam rgyal gyis spyod 'jug gi gzhung phral nas smon 'jug sdom pa rim gyis len par mdzad kyang*/ slob dpon nag po zhabs kyi dka' 'grel las/ smon 'jug so sor len na gzhung phral nas len la/ stabs su len na gzhung ji lta ba bzhin len par gsungs pas/ 'di ni gzhung ji lta ba bzhin stabs su len pa'i lugs kyi cho ga yin no// de rnams kyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chen/ bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga dbu ma lugs zhes yongs su grags pa'i bka' srol chen po de nyid legs par phul grub pa yin pas/ ji skad bshad pa'i bslab bya rnams mi nyams par bsrung ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don ci nus bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyis/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs brjod la/ de ltar na rang re rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa yang dag par 'bogs pa dang blangs pa dag las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa cig yod pa de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi phyir yongs su bsngo dgos pas bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs pa zhu zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab bo// gang zhig thos pa deng 'dir kun las don che zhing*// yid la byas pas gzhan don spro ba mchog tu brtas// nyams su blangs la snying po'i mchog rab nges par ster// theg chen mdo sde kun gyi brjod bya'i snying po mchog

/ring nas mdza' gcugs dkar po'i 'dzum gyis mi bsu zhing*// yid srubs 'jo sgeg lang tsho ngom pas 'drid min par// rigs yod gang zag kun kyang theg pa cher dkri la// mthong na yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog 'di su zhig bskrun// thogs med rgyal ba'i sras chen bzang po'i cho ga'i lus// yan lag kun nas ma tshang med byas ngo mtshar gyi// ltad mo gang la blta phyir lhags pa'i karti kaḥ /ma 'khrugs yi ge'i rnam par sprul te blta ba snyam// 'on kyang mthas gtugs dben pa'i lus can srid dang zhi'i// mtha' chen gnyis las 'gong ba mi gnas mya ngan las// 'das pa theg chen zab rgya che ba'i grong khyer mchog bde bar 'dren byed cho ga'i shing rta 'di ngas byas// tshangs pa rang gis sprul par khas 'ches 'jig rten par// sman 'dogs dpag yas 'byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul 'di 'dra zhig /sngon chad ma shes 'gyod pas gnyid du ma yur ba'i// rang mtshang lta byed 'dzums pa med pa'i skye ba blangs// bklags pas dgos don grub pa byas la 'di na 'ga'// smin ma yon pos bltar bcas mchu 'dab ches g.yo bas// shub bus bshung bar gyur kyang rnam dag cho ga'i gzhung*// gzu lum brtsams pa med phyir kho bor 'gyod pa ci// rnam dkar dge bas yang 'byung srid pa kun du bdag /skyon med tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pas bdag rgyud bsdams// gtsug lag phyi nang snang ba yongs bzung dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i phrin las ci yang sgrub par shog /ces dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga theg chen grong mchog 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang pos mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga gzhir bzung*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bkra shis bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kho bor ji ltar stsal ba'i phyag len rnams brjed pas 'jigs nas thog mar zur rgyan du thor btab pa/

slar yang rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed gnam lo shar bar rang 'dra'i skal mnyam 'ga' la phan pa'i rgyur 'gyur snyam pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen por ston pa mchog gi zhal lung dri ma med pas mngon par bsngags shing*/ ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che la mkhas tshul gsum gyi bgyi ba yang dag par bgyis pa'i dad sgrol e waṃ pa chen po kun dga' bzang po pa zhes yongs su grags pa gang de'i lugs mchog rnam par dag pa'i rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bskyud tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tha snyad du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can bsnyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pas dpal lhun grub steng rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa 'dis kyang sems can thams cad theg pa chen po'i phyogs su gzhol ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
